Definition: a Gibathite, or inhabitant of Gibath
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, Gibʻâthîy means a Gibeathite, an inhabitant of Gibeath. It occurs just once, in 1 Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gibʻâthîy as it stands — a Gibeathite, an inhabitant of Gibeath — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
